title: BCMT: Blockwise Causal Memory Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2608.13578v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transformer architectures rely on dense self-attention to model long-range dependencies, but this mechanism exhibits quadratic complexity with respect to sequence length. We introduce BCMT (Blockwise Causal Memory Transformer), an architecture for long-context language modeling that decouples local token interactions from global context propagation. Dense causal self-attention is applied independently within local blocks, while each block produces an adaptive summary aggregated through an exponential causal memory. This memory is subsequently injected back into the token representations, enabling efficient propagation of long-range contextual information without relying on explicit global attention. Unlike standard Transformers and recurrent memory architectures, BCMT maintains neither dense interactions between distant tokens nor learned memory states. translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13578v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：Transformer架构依赖密集的自注意力来建模长距离依赖，但这种机制在序列长度上表现出二次复杂度。我们引入了BCMT（块状因果记忆Transformer），这是一种用于长上下文语言建模的架构，它将局部令牌交互与全局上下文传播解耦。密集因果自注意力在局部块内独立应用，而每个块通过指数因果记忆生成自适应摘要。该记忆随后被注入回令牌表示中，从而实现长距离上下文信息的高效传播，而无需依赖显式的全局注意力。与标准Transformer和循环记忆架构不同，BCMT既不维持远距离令牌间的密集交互，也不维护学习到的记忆状态。其记忆机制完全可并行化，并与标准i（截断）兼容。
tldr: BCMT通过块状局部自注意力与可并行化的指数因果记忆机制，在无需全局注意力或学习记忆状态的情况下实现高效的长上下文建模，突破了二次复杂度瓶颈。
en_tdlr: BCMT achieves efficient long-context modeling via blockwise local self-attention and a parallelizable exponential causal memory, eliminating global attention and learned memory states to overcome quadratic complexity.
